changelog: New look: the light flight deck design with FoxDesk blue, rounded pill controls and framed content; the sidebar is an icon rail by default (expand it from the menu), phones get a bottom navigation bar, and a running timer stays visible in the top bar

Dashboard rebuilt for staff: billable amount for the period with the change against the previous period, people and clients, worked hours per day, what needs your attention, the recent activity feed and recently updated tickets; switching period or Me/Team updates the page in place

Ticket list: one Filter button holds all filters and the full sort list, columns sort by clicking their headers, rows offer quick actions (take, start timer, reply), due dates and time can be edited inline, Done tickets are grouped by when they were completed, and the list loads more rows as you scroll

Ticket detail: the status pipeline sits in the header, actions moved into the properties card, the timer, work log and conversation are consolidated, assigning a ticket asks for an optional handoff note, and you can log time for a comment or as standalone work
Admins and agents can enter an earlier Created at date for new tickets and replies, for example when recording work done by phone
Images pasted into a ticket are stored as ticket attachments, so they stay visible to everyone who can see the ticket
New ticket form shows image thumbnails for selected attachments

Removed obsolete scripts and stylesheets replaced by the new interface (ticket-detail-core.js, ticket-detail-workflow.js, ticket-list-actions.js, new-ticket.css, report-page.css, ticket-detail.css); the updater deletes them
